name: omr-ionic-frontend
description: Ionic (Angular) mobile frontend for the OMR grading system

notes.install: This file lists ONLY the packages this feature needs. Merge these entries into your existing Ionic project's package.json, then run `npm install`, rather than treating this as a standalone project.
notes.capacitor_permissions: After `npx cap sync`, add camera + storage permissions in android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml (CAMERA, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) and ios/App/App/Info.plist (NSCameraUsageDescription, NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription) or the native camera/gallery pickers will silently fail on-device.
